$comment: Design-System Alignment scores (roadmap 92.3). SOURCE OF TRUTH for what renders on component pages — never hand-type a score into a page. Each dimension is 0-3 with a checkable citation; `na` leaves the denominator. Full reasoning lives in .roundtable/scorecard-*.md; this file carries what the docs display. Re-take a score when a component's design changes, and update `scored` to that date.

colour.cite: zero raw hex in money.css; pairs covered by check:contrast

spacing.cite: 9rem max-inline-size floor is uncommented; the 6rem min carries its reason (89.2)

interaction.cite: native select + input; lossless reformat dispatches real input events so dirty-tracking composes

content.cite: captions name meanings; the family-rule paragraph is the exemplar

fit.cite: docs name every context per the field matrix, incl. where the joined control does NOT belong (in-cell)

content.cite: captions state meaning, incl. the unsuitable-context callout

fit.cite: matrix contexts named; steppers explicitly scoped to touch, not dense grids (80.2)

hierarchy.cite: zero primary .bo-btn across the page's 14 demos (grepped); bulk actions are --secondary

spacing.cite: 1.75rem compaction row-heights are uncommented magic numbers; the 1px/2px/3px are intrinsic border/accent widths

interaction.cite: selection works via :has() with zero JS; behaviors are opt-in; focus restored across htmx swaps; menus are native popover
